mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_menu WHERE menu_id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM auth_menu m JOIN auth_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN auth_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = '0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0'

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM auth_menu m JOIN auth_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN auth_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.visible = '0' AND m.status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT FROM auth_menu
ORDER BY menu_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT FROM auth_menu
ORDER BY menu_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_menu (menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark) VALUES (#{menuName}, #{parentId}, #{orderNum}, #{path}, #{component}, #{menuType}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_menu SET menu_name = #{menuName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, order_num = #{orderNum}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, menu_type = #{menuType}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status}, perms = #{perms}, icon = #{icon}, remark = #{remark} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND del_flag = '0'
